name: stage_1_gated_trot_bri
description:
2026-06-01 Stage 3.D smoke variant: Phase 7.5.R gated-trot reward shape + Bernoulli-impulse actuation backend. Curriculum overrides actuation_backend = bernoulli_impulse to test the backend produces motion (not just bit-identical-when-off). Single stage, no auto-advance.

Bri params: bri_base_rate=0.5 (baseline 50% fire rate per tick per joint), bri_command_bias=0.5 (|u|=1 -> 100% fire rate), bri_impulse_per_spike=0.05 (5% of TARGET_RANGE moved per spike), bri_friction_per_tick=0.05 (offset decays toward rest by 5% per tick — half-life ~14 ticks). Calibration target: at full asymmetry (u=1, fire every tick), equilibrium offset = impulse/friction = 0.05/0.05 = 1.0 = full TARGET_RANGE. Matches the discrete backend's saturated target.
